ways.label: Brewster Track, car park to Brewster Hut and return

start.name: car park at Fantail Falls
start.quote: The track starts from Fantail Falls.

end.name: Brewster Hut
end.quote: Brewster Track ends at the hut

via.name: Haast River crossing (unbridged)
via.quote: The track crosses the unbridged Haast River

via.name: bush line
via.quote: the track climbs steadily through beech forest to the bush line

via.name: snow grass face and narrow ridge
via.quote: the track continues up a snow grass face and onto a narrow ridge leading up towards Brewster Hut

evidence: The track starts from Fantail Falls.
Brewster Track ends at the hut and there is no track to Mt Armstrong or Brewster Glacier.
the Haast River may rise during your hike and mean you cannot cross the river back to the car park.

doubts: The start is described only as the car park and 'from Fantail Falls'; F1 (where the Fantail Falls Walk meets the Haast Pass Highway) is taken as that car park. Shape is from DOC's 'return via same track'.
